query:
SELECT id, claim_number, kinga_ref, status, workflow_state, 
       ai_assessment_triggered, ai_assessment_completed,
       ai_assessment_started_at, ai_assessment_completed_at,
       fraud_risk_score, created_at, updated_at
FROM claims
WHERE claim_number LIKE '%F75D99DD%'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 5;
